test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
The details of books of 6 subjects on the first floor of the college library are given in the following table.

 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 
English

 
 
 
French

 
 
 
Computers

 
 
 
Circ
solution:
**Given:**

Maths books = 17,462

Computers books = 14,308

Circuit Theory books = 9,948

Graph Theory books = 642

**Formula used:**

Ratio = (Maths + Computers) / (Circuit Theory + Graph Theory)

**Calculation:**

Ratio = (17,462 + 14,308) / (9,948 + 642)

⇒ Ratio = 31,770 / 10,590

⇒ Ratio = 3:1

**∴ The ratio of Maths and Computers to Circuit Theory and Graph Theory is 3:1.**
